claims.quote: Schistura kloetzliae is a nemacheilid loach known only from the Mengla River system in Yunnan, China, and Luang Namtha province, northern Laos.

regions.quote: Schistura kloetzliae is a nemacheilid loach known only from the Mengla River system in Yunnan, China, and Luang Namtha province, northern Laos.

regions.name: Mekong
regions.quote: The Mengla is a tributary of the upper Mekong basin and S. kloetzliae has been collected from several of its tributaries including the Nanlahae, Mozhehe, and Nam Youan.
